defs.def: a popular style of clothes, hair, etc. at a particular time or place; the state of being popular （衣服、发式等的）流行款式，时兴式样

ex.s: “Plants are in fashion right now,” says Dr Melinda Knuth, a researcher from the University of Florida.
ex.t: 独自进食，尤其是在电视或电脑前，往往导致无意识的暴饮暴食。

As I dreamt bigger, I began looking into college courses for Fashion Design and three months later I signed up for a part-time design course.
ex.t: 当我梦想更大的时候我开始关注大学里的时装设计课程三个月后我报名参加了一个兼职设计课程。

ex.s: As it became clearer that fashion was what I wanted to do full time, the reality of my day-to-day work at the insurance company became harder.
ex.t: 随着情况越来越清楚时尚是我想要全职从事的现实中日复一日在保险公司的工作变得越来越难熬。

ex.s: Today I am living a creative life as the designer of my own fashion brand.
ex.t: 今天作为一名自有时装品牌的设计师我过着富有创造性的生活。

ex.s: Some of the fur ends up in the fashion shows like the one in Brooklyn last month.
ex.t: 一些毛皮最终出现在像上个月布鲁克林那场这样的时装秀上。

ex.s: Then there’s Righteous Fur and its unusual fashion.
ex.t: 还有Righteous Fur及其独特的时尚。

ex.s: Through his fascination with what people were wearing, and not who they were, he opened the doors of fashion to everyone — fashion as he saw it belonged to the people, not just to high society and big brands.
ex.t: 通过对人们穿着什么而不是这些人是谁的着迷，他为每一个人打开了时尚的大门——在他看来，时尚属于人民，而不仅仅是上流社会和大品牌。

ex.s: Although he was a world-famous fashion photographer, Cunningham’s approach to life was uncomplicated.
ex.t: 尽管坎宁安是一位世界著名的时尚摄影师，但他的生活方式却很简单。

ex.s: Cunningham never accepted the benefits offered to him for being a fashion photographer.
ex.t: 坎宁安从不接受因他是时尚摄影师而给予他的任何优待。

ex.s: His hard work made him more than a fashion photographer — he was a “cultural anthropologist”, who we can thank for recording the life of a whole city and its people over half a century.
ex.t: 他的辛勤工作使他不仅仅是一位时尚摄影师——他是一位“文化人类学家”，我们应该感谢他为整整半个世纪记录了一座城市的全貌和它的人民。

ex.s: The intricately fashioned objects that have stood still for centuries instantly come back to life: water flows, boats sail, dogs bark, chickens flap their wings and a woman starts to spin.
ex.t: 那些历经数百年静止不动的、制作精巧的物品，瞬间焕发了生机：水流了起来，船划了起来，狗叫了起来，鸡扇动着翅膀，一个女人开始纺纱。
